content.short: AKEDO turns plain-language prompts into playable web3 games on BNB Chain, then lets creators launch a token for each one.
content.description: AKEDO is a game creation platform where a team of AI agents does the building. One agent sketches the world, another writes the rules, a third tunes the balance and a fourth handles story, and a prompt becomes a playable game in a couple of minutes. Finished games can carry ads, share protocol revenue, or get their own token on a bonding curve paired with $AKE. The platform runs on BNB Chain and opBNB. AKEDO describes itself as a vibe coding engine and launchpad for content creators, and it counts Karatage, Sfermion and Collab+Currency among its backers.
content.meta: Describe a game in words and AKEDO's agents build it, then launch a creator token for it on BNB Chain. Explore AKEDO on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
